nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.label: Prompt
nodes.text: Turn this 3D render into a photorealistic photograph taken with a full-frame camera: realistic materials and reflections, natural soft shadows, realistic surroundings, natural daylight. Keep exactly the same composition, camera angle, object shapes and background.

nodes.name: How to use
nodes.label: How to use
nodes.text:
1. Light the scene and set the camera
   (Cycles renders materials, HDRI, shadows)
2. Describe the photo you want in Prompt
3. Run Graph: the render runs first
   (progress on the Cycles node, ✕ stops it)
4. Viewer shows the result; Save keeps a copy
